research_question: With the rapid increase in virtual consultations for healthcare visits reported since 2023, what marketing strategies can MediConn Solutions adopt to continue attracting new customers?

public_industry_facts: CIHI notes that virtual primary care can reduce the need to travel and can improve access for patients in underserved areas.
CIHI describes virtual care as including video or telephone appointments and asynchronous services such as secure messaging.
CIHI identifies technology comfort and patients having a choice of how to access care as considerations for implementing virtual primary care.
internal_company_metrics: 80% of MediConn's customers state that they prefer using its services to its competitors.

Based on a marketing department report from May 2024, potential customers are 60% more likely to start using MediConn services after encountering in-person marketing in comparison to encountering digital ads.
During our last Facebook ad push, there was an increase of 10% in new patient sign-ups, 6% of which were referred directly to the MediConn site through Facebook ad links.
